_comment: Paste this into api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From an app manifest. It grants read access to conversation history and the ability to post in a channel or open a DM. There is no app_mention subscription and no slash command: this agent is never invoked, it decides on its own.

display_information.name: ClueBro
display_information.description: Reads the room. Speaks only when it has something useful to add.
